evals.prompt: Design naming for a new Tauri CRUD resource called `resource` with insert/read/update/remove. Show the IPC strings, Rust command function names with rename attributes, service method names, and entity param enums using One|Many. Output a short markdown cheat sheet only — no real project paths.
evals.expected_output: Four-layer naming cheat sheet using namespace:action, resource_* commands with rename, to* services, *P::One|Many
expectations: IPC names use namespace:action with colon separator (e.g. resource:read)
No IPC snake_case or camelCase command strings
Rust command fn names use resource_ prefix with rename = "resource:..."
Service methods use to* style (toRead, toInsert, toUpdate, toRemove)
Entity params use One|Many single entry (not insert/inserts dual commands)
Output contains no real repo paths or concrete business module names from a specific codebase

evals.prompt:
A teammate wrote these invokes — fix them to follow Tauri naming conventions and explain each fix in one line:
1) invoke('feature_update_badge', { hasBadge: true })
2) invoke('feature:updateBadge', { hasBadge: true })
3) invoke('feature/set-badge', { hasBadge: true })
4) invoke('resource:update', { id: 'x' }) where the entity expects { params: UpdateP }
Return corrected TypeScript snippets only plus brief notes.
evals.expected_output: Corrected invokes using feature:update-badge and resource:update with params wrapper; notes citing snake_case/camelCase/slash/set/params issues
expectations: Corrected badge IPC is feature:update-badge (kebab-case, update- not set-)
resource:update uses params-shaped payload matching Entity

evals.prompt:
Code-review this proposed Tauri API for naming issues and propose renames:
- Commands: pub fn read(...), pub fn inserts(...), pub fn set_mode(...)
- Registered without rename (IPC would be read / inserts / set_mode)
- Service: async fn read_all, async fn insert_many
- Types: ResourceInsertParams for single, ResourceInsertParamsList for batch
Write a review checklist result and the corrected four-layer names using abstract `resource` / `feature` namespaces.
evals.expected_output: Review catching missing namespace prefix, dual insert entry, set_*, non-to* service, verbose type names; corrected names per conventions
expectations: Flags bare command names without namespace prefix as collision risk
Flags inserts dual-entry; recommends One|Many single insert command
Replaces set_mode with update-mode style IPC
Recommends to* service names instead of read_all / insert_many
Recommends short *P types over ResourceInsertParams duplication
